## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Forest of the Yì, Upper and Lower Classics (= Jiāoshì Yì lín)*

by [焦贛](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%84%A6%E8%B4%9B) (Jiāo Gòng / Jiāo Yánshòu)

**The *Jiāoshì Yì lín*** 焦氏易林 — **the great Western-Hàn *Yì jīng* divination compendium**, providing 4,096 four-line divinatory verses, one for each ordered pair of the 64 hexagrams. One of the most important early Hàn *Yì* tradition works. Catalogued here from other sources (not preserved in the Dào zàng proper).

**Dating.** Western Hàn. Dynasty: 西漢.
